scripts.db:studio: docker compose up -d db pgweb && echo '\n  Dev DB → http://localhost:8081\n'
scripts.db:studio:test: docker compose up -d db-test pgweb-test && echo '\n  Test DB → http://localhost:8082\n'
scripts.db:reset: docker compose exec db psql -U gatewasm -d gatewasm -c 'DROP SCHEMA public CASCADE; CREATE SCHEMA public;' && echo 'Dev DB wiped — restart server to re-run migrations'
scripts.db:reset:test: docker compose exec db-test psql -U gatewasm -d gatewasm_test -c 'DROP SCHEMA public CASCADE; CREATE SCHEMA public;' && echo 'Test DB wiped'
scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,frontend -c blue,green "npm run dev:server" "npm run dev:frontend"
scripts.clean:all: rm -rf node_modules admin/node_modules admin/dist target package-lock.json admin/package-lock.json && npm cache clean --force
scripts.fresh: npm run clean:all && npm install && cd admin && npm install && cd .. && npm run build:ssr
